Training Topic / Competency Item: training to each employee who is required by this section to use PPE
Purpose: Ensures each employee required to use personal protective equipment is trained in when, what, how, and its limitations and care
Approval Basis: Employer provides PPE training and verifies it through its own written certification under 8 CCR 3380(f)(7); no external body approves the training.
Frequency: Before being allowed to perform work requiring the use of PPE; retraining when the employer has reason to believe the employee lacks the required understanding and skill
Notes / Research Flags: [AUTO] Cross-setting enumeration: Cal/OSHA universal employer duty, 14 settings | [AUTO] Impact basis: Section 3380(f)(4) requires PPE training on the five enumerated points; (f)(5) requires each affected employee to demonstrate understanding and the ability to use PPE before performing work requiring it, (f)(6) requires retraining where that understanding or skill is lacking, and (f)(7) requires a written certification naming each employee trained, dates, and subject. (confidence High) | [AUTO] Cross-setting enumeration: Cal/OSHA universal employer duty, 14 settings. Universal Cal/OSHA employer duty binding every California employer, therefore all 14 HSTM settings. Explicit Training on a five-item enumerated topic list plus the § 3380(f)(5) demonstration-of-understanding requirement. Scope is an 'all staff' employer mandate; HSTM Role enumerates the workforce buckets that plausibly apply in a health care employer rather than all eight. Reviewer may widen or narrow. | Self-refutation check: the Section 3206 approval requirement in 3380(a)(2) attaches to the personal protective equipment, and the written certification is the employer's own - neither is program approval.
